summary: OppFi Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary, Opportunity Funding SPE Residual, LLC, drew $75.0 million on September 15, 2026 under a senior secured multi-draw term loan dated August 10, 2026, with UMB Bank as agent. The facility allows up to $100.0 million at 12.50% pre-BNCCORP acquisition and 13.50% after, carries a 1.25% original issue discount, four-year maturity, and semi-annual 10% amortization. The $25.0 million remaining is available through February 10, 2027. This is a routine credit facility creation, not a special situation. Watch covenant compliance and drawdowns tied to the pending bank acquisition.
